title: I'm in actual pain!
description: Cursed (and neat) soundpack that makes players express agony when they take damage!
body:
This soundpack is designed to work with any version of Minecraft that supports ressource packs.

It means to replace every sounds that the player makes when they get hurt.

It offers;

- 3; for when the player gets hit
- 3; for when the player stands on sizzling grounds 
- 4; for when the player forgets to catch a breath underwater
- 5; for when the player's slowly freezing to death
- and 2; for when the player's too clumsy around those damn berry bushes

Please note that some versions of Minecraft can't play some of them, because those sound-specifics are not in the game default by itself.
